name: Arxygen AIWrite
author: Paul Ledbrook

sections.description:
IMPORTANT: You must have an Arxygen AIWrite account for this plugin to function.

Sign up at write.arxygen.com and obtain an API key before using this plugin.

Arxygen AIWrite is an AI-powered content creation, scheduling, and publishing platform that takes all the pain out of the entire content writing process while maintaining exceptional quality. Produce 50 pages of content with 5 minutes work, compared to 20+ hours with other AI tools.

This plugin connects your WordPress website to the Arxygen AIWrite service, allowing fully automated publishing via API every 15 minutes.
Note: In this version you will be alerted via email that a new article has been published to pending on your WordPress site.
All you need to do is check you are happy with it in the WordPress standard editor and then click publish.

Without an Arxygen account, this plugin will not function.

Arxygen AIWrite is built for businesses, bloggers, and marketers who want to leverage AI content writing, scale their content strategies, and maintain top-level article quality with minimal effort.

Key Features

  • Incredibly easy – Very easy to install, set up and get publishing amazing content.
  • Massive time savings – Set up any campaign in just 5 minutes to schedule and publish up to 50 AI-generated articles. 5 minutes work vs 20+ hours with most of our competitors
  • SEO-optimized content – All AI-written articles follow search-friendly best practices
  • 12-tier quality adjustment system – Fine-tunes AI content to ensure high-quality output
  • Multi-domain support – Manage multiple websites from one Arxygen account
  • Automated scheduled publishing – Set up your campaigns and let our system publish content automatically
  • Cost-effective – Clear pricing from as little as £0.30 per article, with bulk discounts available

Sign up and get 10 FREE credits

External Services

Arxygen AIWrite Service
– This plugin calls https://write.arxygen.com/scripts/arxygen-proc-view.php to facilitate publishing Arxygen AI-generated content to your WordPress site.
– It sends your domain and private key to authenticate your account.
– If new content for your domain is found, it is sent back to this plugin and published.
– See our Terms & Privacy Policy for details on how your data is handled.
sections.installation:
1. Sign up for an Arxygen AIWrite account at write.arxygen.com and obtain your API key.
  2. Download the Arxygen AIWrite plugin from WordPress.org or directly from your Arxygen AIWrite account.
  3. Upload and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  4. Go to “Settings > Arxygen”, enter your API key and admin email, and save.
    • The admin email you provide will receive notifications about newly published content
    • You can also enable advanced logging if you need detailed troubleshooting information
  5. Set up a campaign at write.arxygen.com and watch your content auto-publish as often as every 15 minutes!
sections.faq:
Do I need an Arxygen AIWrite account?

Yes. The plugin requires an active Arxygen AIWrite account to function. You’ll need an API key to publish content.

Sign up for an account and get 10 FREE credits

Do I have to pay for the Arxygen plugin?

No, the plugin is free to install and use. However, content generation requires purchasing credits in the Arxygen AIWrite platform. New users get 10 free credits (limited to one per organisation).

What Can Arxygen AIWrite Do?

Arxygen AIWrite helps you produce and publish high-quality articles with minimal input. Set up different campaign types with just a few clicks:
Here are just a few of the possible ways to use our system:
– Consistent Blogging: Create 2 * 1200 word articles every week, publishing schedule = weekly for 25 weeks (50 articles total)
– Content Blitz: Generate 5 * 1800 word articles every day, publishing schedule = daily for 10 days (50 articles total)
– Instant Content Library: Produce 25 * 1500 word articles in 1 day, publishing schedule = all published in a single day (25 articles total)

Note: Campaigns can be for 1 to 50 articles. You can run multiple campaigns for the same website at the same time – this allows you to set up different parameters for each campaign to get a mix of styles, voices, article length, marketing targets all publishing at similar times.

Why use Arxygen AIWrite instead of Jasper or other AI writers?

Other AI content tools are cumbersome, time-consuming, unpredictable, and don’t help your content strategy scale. As shown in our comparison:

  • Arxygen completes 50 pages in under 2 hours compared to 20+ hours with competitors
  • Offers easy, transparent pricing (as little as £0.30 per page) versus highly variable costs elsewhere
  • Features automatic content scheduling and WordPress publishing with minimal setup
  • Includes a 12-tier adjustment system to fine-tune and check AI content quality

See why Arxygen AIWrite is better than the rest!

How does Arxygen AIWrite help website owners?

  • No more manual writing – AI handles content generation automatically
  • Set-and-forget publishing – Plan your articles and publishing schedule in advance
  • SEO-focused – Customizable content for targeted audiences
  • Continuous fresh content – Schedule content for daily, weekly, or monthly posting
  • Advanced HTML formatting – Creates properly formatted content automatically

Can I build a campaign to produce and publish 50 high-quality articles in 5 minutes?

Yes! The process is incredibly simple:

1. Sign up (30 sec) → 2. Set up a campaign (3 min) → 3. Install the plugin (1 min)

That’s it! The system automatically handles everything else.

How often does the plugin check for new content?

The plugin checks for new content every 15 minutes and can also be triggered manually from the settings page.

What post status are new articles published as?

By default, articles are published with “pending” status so you can review them before making them live. You’ll receive an email notification for each new post.
